name: Limited-Time Events
tagline: Temporary content, challenges, or reward tracks that expire on a fixed deadline, creating urgency to engage now.
desc: Missing a limited-time event means a permanent gap in collection or standing, for the Competitor, painful enough to override low-motivation days. Events create shared, simultaneous community experiences. The expiration date does psychological work that permanent content cannot.
principle: Urgency created by scarcity of time. The event interrupts the user's default relationship with the app.
warn: Overuse creates event fatigue where users stop treating events as special. The cadence matters as much as the content.
lifecycle: Effective across all lifecycle stages. Useful for re-engaging dormant users.
